core_obligations: a) 实质要求：对三元组的短正合列证明 Euler 特征的可加性 chi(G)=chi(F)+chi(H)。b) 允许引用：证明内逐处引用的既有 chi 定义与有限性结果。c) 必须由本证明完成的部分：把 chi 按项展开为有限和的差并沿短正合列记账。d) 原文定位：algebraization.tex 8132-8146（陈述）、8148-8283（证明）。判 H2：可加性记账型工具引理，机制为定义展开与有限性核对，第 (iii) 条不满足。未逐行读，建议复核。
items.difficulty_reason: H2: Chi additivity for coherent triples over the punctured spectrum of a Noetherian local ring with a nonzerodivisor f in its maximal ideal. Given Artin-Rees, Snake and finite-length additivity, the initial lattice maps need not be compatible: the author isolates a closed-point-supported obstruction delta, kills it by m^k, replaces Gprime by m^n Gprime and Fprime by its intersection with Fprime, and uses Artin-Rees to force delta_n=0 before the final exact-diagram length calculation. This obstruction-clearing construction is the residual core. Category additive, not assumed abelian; no unrelated f-adic-completeness assumption imported.

dedup.scope: Exact fixed-version coherent-triple claim and chi/Euler primary scope; unrelated triple-product Euler-system results have different hypotheses/conclusion.
